title: wtm global config
description: Schema for ~/.config/wtm/config.toml — per-user defaults applied across all projects.

shell.description: Shell wrapper generated by `wtm shell init`. The wrapper enables `wt go` / `wt switch` to change the working directory.

animations.description: Whether `wtm ui` animates its tab rule and a newly created row. Absent means on; set to false to disable every dashboard animation at once.

check.description: Whether wtm checks GitHub for a newer release at most once a day and prints a notice on stderr. Absent means on; set to false to disable it. WTM_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 disables it for a single run.
